# Copilot Instructions

This workspace uses the official MATLAB MCP Core Server from MathWorks.

- MCP config lives in [`.vscode/mcp.json`](../.vscode/mcp.json).
- The server binary is downloaded to [`.tools/matlab-mcp-core-server/matlab-mcp-core-server-win64.exe`](../.tools/matlab-mcp-core-server/matlab-mcp-core-server-win64.exe).
- MATLAB on this machine is installed at `C:\Program Files\MATLAB\R2025b`.
- Official server documentation: https://github.com/matlab/matlab-mcp-core-server
- MCP configuration guidance: https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/copilot/customization/mcp-servers

Use the configured MCP server for MATLAB code generation, analysis, and execution tasks when appropriate.
